prose: In this episode I will be continuing my research into the cult of the medics by speaking with Chance Garton from the InnerVerse Podcast & maverick symbolism researcher Gabriel Peters about the medical cult's sorcery right at the birth of a baby in hospital, how it connects to the occult aspects of the legal system, the dark goddess (Medusa / MedUSA) and the serpent symbolism behind it all. I believe this discussion will help add more context to the many themes in my Cult of the Medics docuseries, which you can watch for free at the link below. We will also be taking a look into the occult aspects behind human trafficking, maritime law, child exploitation, and much more.
